scope: CPU float32, one-layer explicit-write/read memory blocks. Native published recurrences with a common small encoder; not full Kimi Linear/GDN-2 models, official Zoology MQAR, fused kernels or GPU throughput.
feature_encoders: Shared query/key tanh trunk. Native: SiLU on the final M-feature projection followed by L2 normalization, avoiding a linear hidden-rank bottleneck. Structured: bounded tanh latent projection, learned positive polynomial coefficients, exact degree-two collected features and L2 normalization. No persistent index/basis buffers.
preflight_correction: Discarded a linear-head native baseline before any main test run; restarted all tuning with the nonlinear head. Final test data were not used to make that correction.

matching.recurrent_state: Exactly 225*16 float32 scalars = 14400 bytes per episode for all four blocks; encoder/gates/optimizer/activations reported separately.
matching.parameters: Common cap of 32768 active float32 parameters (128 KiB), largest fitting hidden width, within 2.5% of cap; no persistent basis/index buffers or unused padding. Optimizer state scales with actual parameter count.
matching.training_cost: Primary: equal process CPU seconds, one intra-op/inter-op thread. Includes synthetic batch generation, feature/coefficient preparation, all forward/backward, clipping and AdamW; excludes evaluation/checkpoint I/O. One final step may overshoot; actual times reported.
matching.secondary: Same-seed data-stream prefix at the largest predeclared common step milestone reached by every block. Equal examples, not a compute-equivalence claim. Peak training activation/RSS memory is not matched or claimed equal.
matching.tuning: Equal two-learning-rate CPU budget per architecture and key dimension, separate seed and validation keys; select on mean recall_16/overwrite_16 accuracy. Never select on final test data.

task.keys: Independent Gaussian vectors normalized to unit length, fresh each episode. Query keys equal stored keys. Values are independent uniform 16-way classes encoded one-hot.
task.training: Uniform 4/8/16 target associations; independently 25% episodes add pairs/2 overwrites and 25% add pairs/2 unrelated writes. All target keys queried in shuffled order after writes; query events do not alter memory.
task.primary_test_score: Unweighted mean of recall_16 and overwrite_16 accuracy, same fixed held-out episodes across models and seeds.
task.limitations: Explicit episode boundaries, write/read masks, one-hot values and shared query/key encoder simplify the task. Synthetic diagnostic only; no natural-language generalization claim.

decision_rule.advantage: Require positive paired primary-score differences in every training seed and a positive descriptive paired 95% t interval; also inspect overwrite/longer-context behavior and measured end-to-end cost. Three seeds only supports a pilot conclusion.
decision_rule.negative: If matched-state learned features win reliably, record no advantage for this tested structured family, preserve results, and do not justify custom kernels from state counts.

runtime.compiler_flags: Prebuilt PyTorch CPU wheel; no custom compiled kernel
